description:
The Simple Glide Low Seat Recumbent E-Trike takes everything riders love about the original Simple Glide and makes it even more comfortable, stable, and versatile. Designed with a lower seating position and an extended frame, this model allows riders to pedal with their legs stretched more naturally out in front of them—delivering improved ergonomics and a grounded, confident feel on every ride.

Perfect for seniors, casual riders, or anyone looking for a smooth and secure electric trike, this new version combines comfort, performance, and utility in one thoughtfully designed package.

Key Features & Upgrades

Lower, Recumbent Seating – Seat is positioned closer to the ground with a more extended frame, letting you pedal in a forward-reclined posture for comfort and stability.

Out-in-Front Pedaling Motion – A more natural and ergonomic riding position reduces strain on hips, knees, and back.

Rear Basket with Pet-Friendly Space – Built-in storage directly behind the seat, perfect for carrying groceries, bags, or even your furry co-pilot.

Hydraulic Disc Brakes (Upgraded) – Improved stopping power with less hand effort, ensuring safer, smoother braking on all terrain.

Trailer & Seat Hitch Attachment – Equipped with a hitch mount for attaching a cargo trailer, child seat, or additional passenger seat.

Fat Tires for Stability – Wide tires absorb bumps and provide traction on pavement, dirt, gravel, and grass.

Throttle & Pedal Assist Modes – Choose full electric throttle, pedal assist, or manual pedaling to match your comfort and energy.

Long-Range Power – Powered by a 750W motor and 20Ah battery (up to 50 miles per charge depending on terrain, rider weight, and assist level).

Comfort-First Design – Armrests, step-through frame, and ergonomic positioning make mounting, riding, and dismounting easy for all riders.
